title: White and Scarlet Dye
summary: Single-use dye recolours compatible equipment white and scarlet.

fields.Use: Combine with compatible equipment or clothes. The new dye replaces a prior dye. Dye Remover restores the original colours.
fields.Acquisition: Possible random merchant stock starting at level 5.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
